final_recovery.image_hash_unavailable_reason: the successful recovery process removed its image before interruption of the parallel O3 build; the original O0 image hash is recorded above

build.terminated_reason: stopped after the architecture control silently accepted the deliberate type error; no further expensive replay was needed for conservative receipts

log_policy: Public logs are raw when <=180000 bytes; larger stderr logs preserve exact unittest result/summary/error headers and up to 20 traceback locations. Each raw hash and byte length is retained.
source_withdrawal: Saved positive images were already removed after their runs, so a source-withdrawal rerun was not practical. Native test methods were executed in Imre-built images; no CPython delegation was used for native suite results.
